lines.t: Before empires rose, before doctrines hardened, the most high spoke, and away was walked.
I stood at the gate where two roads divide
One loud with promise, one quiet with life
The crowd moved fast, their hands held high
But truth stood still and met my eyes
It didn't offer silver or a throne
It asked for my heart, my will, my bones
Leave what you were, come walk and see
Said the living word calling me
Not written on stone alone, but carved in the heart
When the plow let go, not here is the words
But walkers made new, a covenant lived faithful and true
I follow footsteps in the dust
Where truth stays sharp and pride turns to rust
Not my way, not the voice of men
I walked the path he walked back then
Through fire refined, through faith aligned
Breath of the most high filling my lungs
I won't turn back, I won't delay
I'll walk the way
He touched the outcasts, spoke straight to kings
Called out the lie, wrapped in hollow things
He honored the Torah, fulfilled it in light
Lived every word, not one denied
No mask, no blend with the world's applause
He stood unmoved by the threat of loss
Servant's hands, yet authority clear
The kingdom drawn near, right here
Weep it means turn, not feel but create
Change direction, place your steps
Wild road packed but the soul runs dry
Narrow stays quiet but the truth stays alive
Commands ain't changed, their life in motion
Fueled with death, fueled by devotion
Not religion, not culture, not man-made flame
Set apart living, branded by name
Obedience ain't easy, it cuts through the night
Follow the wave, stand up and fight
Dust on your feet, fire in your heart Every small step is a brand new start
Turn from the wide, step in the light Every breath living, walk in its sight
No compromise, no half measures taken Life's fully given when the king awakens
Strip me clean of borrowed names Teach my feet your ancient way
If it cost me all I've been Let obedience be how I win
I follow the footsteps in the dust
Truth before comfort, obedience first
From dawn to dusk, from breath to grave
I choose the life the Father gave
No turning back
No divided way
The narrow path is where I'll stay
Not tradition. Not the world. Only truth. Lived in Yahushua.
We'll see you next time.
